# GX

> GX is the quality layer for agent-written code: capture coding sessions, organize changes into reviewable stacks, and publish richer review context.

## Core workflow

```bash
git add <files>
gx commit -m "describe this revision"
gx status
git push    # or gx push
```

## Docs

- [Overview](/docs): Product model — sessions, revisions, stacks, review bundles
- [Get started](/docs/getting-started): Install, auth, first revision
- [How it works](/docs/how-it-works): Why GX, stacks vs commits
- [CLI](/docs/cli): gx commit, status, push, sync, review, set key
- [MCP Setup](/docs/mcp): gx_commit, gx_status, gx_push, and more
- [GitHub PRs](/docs/github): PR Summaries and @gx chat (paid / trial)
- [API](/docs/reference/api): GX Cloud HTTP APIs
